P.note: Clean, legible, and the glossy blue sphere artwork is good, but the pale plate reads as frosted glass more than blue acrylic and the grass is flat banded with a heavy dark-green foreground strip.

Q.note: Strongest Frutiger Aero translucency with saturated sky and textured electric grass, but white text on the cyan lower queue has weak contrast and the floating bubbles feel generic.

R.note: The prev and next buttons render as blank discs with no glyphs, and the blurred cloud blobs plus muddy teal vinyl art read as generic glassmorphism.

S.note: Overexposed blue-tinted whites are well handled, but the prev and next buttons render blank and the card lacks the depth of coloured acrylic.

T.note: The translucent blue acrylic card and sky bloom read convincingly, but white text on pale teal in the queue lowers contrast and the hills are flat.

U.note: Best balance of overexposed blue-white luminance, electric grass and horizon bloom, with a crafted glass-blue artwork and clearly legible text and controls.
